def transform(grid):
    # The vertical separator divides two equal-width masks. Mark cells occupied
    # in both panels with color 2.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left_w = sep
    right_w = len(grid[0]) - sep - 1
    width = min(left_w, right_w)
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
